field_principles.flagged_for_v382: Closes the discover->ingest->plan loop: names the strongest method for the next planner.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefixed. Records ingestion completed with verifiable citations.
field_principles.methods_mapped: Each method MUST carry a real arXiv ID/URL; an ingestion note without verifiable citations is treated as fabrication.

methods_mapped.failure_mode: A checkpoint can reload and still remain far below the published TRM target, making any verifier-graft conclusion underpowered.
methods_mapped.implementation_over_stack: Resume the nano-trm Sudoku Extreme checkpoint until the baseline reproduction is trustworthy before treating verifier lift as meaningful.
methods_mapped.name: TRM resumable Sudoku baseline gate

methods_mapped.failure_mode: Full fine-tuning can win by public-task adaptation or leakage unless checkpoint source, split, and optimizer budget are isolated.
methods_mapped.implementation_over_stack: Keep a no-verifier full-fine-tune arm beside verifier-admitted training so adaptation compute is not confused with verifier value.
methods_mapped.name: TTA-TRM full-fine-tune control

methods_mapped.failure_mode: Local verifier scores can prefer near-valid dead ends, so final exact validity and prune-error rate must remain authoritative.
methods_mapped.implementation_over_stack: Move exact Sudoku checks into candidate expansion so resumed TRM compute is spent on recoverable partial boards before post-hoc reranking.
methods_mapped.name: Verifier-guided adaptive candidate expansion

methods_mapped.failure_mode: Near-duplicate invalid boards can teach shallow artifacts unless the pool has real within-puzzle diversity.
methods_mapped.implementation_over_stack: Train a selector from exact-valid and verifier-rejected Sudoku traces sampled from the same resumed checkpoint.
methods_mapped.name: V-STaR accepted/rejected Sudoku selector

methods_mapped.failure_mode: If the baseline checkpoint rarely samples valid completions, the cached curriculum collapses into memorization or too few positives.
methods_mapped.implementation_over_stack: Cache generated Sudoku batches, filter them with the Carnot verifier, resume improvement from unique positives, and retain rejects for selectors.
methods_mapped.name: ReST resumable generate-filter-improve curriculum
